text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: —The Mejiro Family.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"It is a prestigious household that has produced countless famed Umamusume
and shaped numerous eras in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Mejiro McQueen... Mejiro Ryan..."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Mejiro Palmer... and an even greater predecessor—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“Their running is still fresh in our memories,
and it continues to strongly captivate people's hearts.”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"'Today, we bring you a special program looking back
at the history of the Mejiro family,
featuring brand-new interview footage――――'"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Among fans, there are voices eagerly anticipating
the rise of a new Mejiro Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, our days of challenging the
Twinkle Series with Mejiro Dober
finally begin...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To help her become the rising star the public expects, I must put even more spirit into my work starting today.
choice_data_list: First, let's go discuss our plans for the future!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the training course
in search of Mejiro Dober—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
That should be enough for the warmup."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's Mejiro Dober-senpai!
She looks so cool today too~♪

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a Mejiro Umamusume.
That cool aura really hits different, huh...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for your debut race!
It's gonna be so awesome~! I totally wanna go watch~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The passionate gazes of younger Umamusume are focused on Mejiro Dober.
It seems many at the academy have high hopes for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if she keeps drawing attention like this,
Mejiro Dober will get way too nervous. Before that happens—"
choice_data_list: Dober, sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Kh, Trainer!?
Don't just shout my name out of nowhere!
And besides, wait for what—
choice_data_list: There are a lot of people watching, so let's move somewhere else first.
There are a lot of people watching, so let's move somewhere else first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ah... Trainer.
No, I haven't been waiting long... so it's okay.
choice_data_list: There are a lot of people watching, so let's move somewhere else first.
There are a lot of people watching, so let's move somewhere else first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...!
I-I understand...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Shall we do that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading Mejiro Dober away from the gallery,
I told her that I wanted to discuss our plans for her debut, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading Mejiro Dober away from the gallery,
I told her that I wanted to discuss our plans for her debut, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Before we get into that. You were... looking out for me, weren't you? Um... thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for earlier.
To be honest, I was in a bind... so you really helped me out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
…………Look.
Seeing as we're heading toward your debut, to reiterate――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
…………Look.
Seeing as we're heading toward your debut, to reiterate――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... want to learn to run properly.
I want to become a strong Umamusume
who can run with confidence no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So... first of all, in my Make Debut,
I want to run my absolute hardest to the finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...What do you mean, 'great'? It's just obvious.
You don't have to force yourself to praise me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
I only stated the obvious, you know?
You don't have to praise me that much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Um, anyway.
That was my declaration of resolve just now.
So... I'll be in your care from now on.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you again too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Um, anyway.
That was my declaration of resolve just now.
So... I'll be in your care from now on.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you again too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nn...
So, about training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
So, about training—
Dober~!
Dober~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff~...
I have been searching for you~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girl waving as she approached was Mejiro Bright.
A fellow Mejiro and classmate, she was an ojou-sama
type of Umamusume who moved at her own easy pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll be right over—kyaa!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Mejiro Bright-senpai!
Are you okay~!?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: That airy, clumsy side of hers... it kinda makes you wanna protect her, or like, it's just cute, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I get it... I feel bad for Senpai,
but I can't help feeling totally warmed by it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, this won't do~.
My feet got all tangled up~.
My mistake, my mistake...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my? It seems everyone is looking at me for some reason~...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good day, everyone~!
It is another splendid day for training~!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Kyaa, Bright-senpa~i!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright responded to her junior Umamusume with such calm and composure that it felt truly majestic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright hasn't changed a bit, has she...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Good day, Dober~
Pardon me for interrupting your training~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good day.
I was just getting started, so you're totally fine.
...What brings you here today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We are to be peers from the same generation, are we not~?
So I came to introduce myself once more...
and offer some encouragement~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As fellow Umamusume of the Mejiro family,
let us push forward together to race through the Twinkle Series~, or so she said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. You're right.
Let's do our best together, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps inspired by Mejiro Bright's words, she looks even more fired up than before.
In that case—
choice_data_list: Since we're here, why don't we run together?
Since we're here, wanna run side-by-side?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, right now?
Bright has her own training to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My~! What a lovely suggestion~.
I've already finished warming up,
so I can join you right away, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course~.
I love running with Dober, after all~.
...That being said~â

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I really would rather not yield the front, you know~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Too bad for you.
Since I'm doing this, even I...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the clear sky, the two deliver a spirited run.
You can tell they are inspiring one another...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa!
The seniors are doing a full-on match race...!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I wonder what'll happen once I debut... I'm getting so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Heheh.
You two both have great looks on your faces!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems you're more than fired up
for your debut, huh."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Fufu. Splendid as always, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Phew—
Bright too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright—
the two of them will definitely become great rivals.
It was a stunning side-by-side run that made me certain of it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's both do our best until our debut races~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I'll make sure... I learn how to run properly too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I vowed in my heart to do my absolute best,
so that I could be a worthy backing to her powerful words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, our days of taking on challenges alongside Mejiro Dober began!
